chars.SAMIRA: SAMIRA: a young Moroccan woman, long wavy black hair, mustard yellow blazer over a white top, small gold hoop earrings
chars.FIANCE: FIANCE: a tall elegant young Moroccan man, slicked-back black hair, neatly trimmed beard, burgundy suit jacket over a black turtleneck, silver watch
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a stern Moroccan father in his sixties, retired army officer, short grey hair, thick grey moustache, olive green cardigan over a beige shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy cafe terrace in Rabat at sunset. FIANCE leans across the small table and whispers a cheeky proposal to SAMIRA with a sly grin; SAMIRA leans back, eyes wide, half shocked half amused, hand on her chest. Comic romantic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Rabat cafe. FIANCE winks playfully and raises his hands as if saying 'anything you want, no problem'; SAMIRA covers her mouth with her hand, blushing and laughing in embarrassment.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: FIANCE and SAMIRA walk hand in hand along the Rabat corniche near the blue and white Kasbah of the Udayas, smiling at each other, ocean in the background, golden light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modern Rabat apartment, FIANCE sits on a sofa next to SAMIRA, holding two plane tickets and a small ring box, making grand promises with an open charming gesture; SAMIRA looks dreamy and convinced.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a traditional Moroccan family home in Rabat. FIANCE stands at the door holding a big box of Moroccan pastries and flowers with a confident smile; FATHER stands in the doorway, arms crossed, frowning suspiciously at him; SAMIRA behind her father, nervous.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Narrow hallway of the Moroccan family home with zellige tiles. FATHER firmly pulls SAMIRA aside by the arm, leaning close and whispering angrily; SAMIRA looks surprised and annoyed. In the far background, out of focus, a guest sits in the salon.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the same hallway, SAMIRA gestures with both hands, passionately defending her fiance; FATHER listens with crossed arms and a skeptical raised eyebrow, unconvinced.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon with low sofas and a silver tea tray. FATHER stands in the doorway staring with worried, narrowed eyes at FIANCE, who sits relaxed on the sofa sipping tea with a mysterious little smirk. Suspense.
